override.note: PARSER BASELINE (HYPOTHESIS — NOT a validated model). Every ⚑ below is an UNMEASURED estimate; hand-tune + record against a real fight before trusting any number. Queen (Makoto) — SG/Fire/Attacker/Burst III. Whole-kit shape: she is a Wind-boss specialist. Fire holds elemental advantage over Wind, and three of her mechanics ('Nuke Boost'/'Nuke Amp' elemAdvantageDamagePct, the '1 More' ATK buff, and the 1-More-gated 548.99% distributed rider + Baton Pass) are live ONLY against a Wind Code boss, so against the neutral/Fire scope-lock boss the modeled kit reduces to: ATK ▲50.28% (battle start + every Full Burst end, 15s), Attack Damage ▲30% passive, Distributed Damage ▲90.01% on Burst-Stage-3 entry, and the 1421.69% distributed burst nuke. '1 More' is modeled as her OWN burst cast + bossElementGate 'Wind' (that is the only place the kit text creates it). 'Follow Up' is NOT produced anywhere in this kit — its 548.99% rider is deliberately UNMODELED rather than given an invented trigger. DEF buffs are carried for kit completeness (defPct is offensively inert in v1).

skill1: ■ Activates when Follow Up takes effect. Affects all enemies. Deals 548.99% of final ATK as distributed damage. (⚑ NOT MODELED: nothing in this kit creates 'Follow Up'; giving it an invented trigger would fabricate up to 548.99% of final ATK per proc)
Persona - Johanna: This effect is continuous and cannot be removed. (buff-name label + dispel immunity; no dispel/cleanse exists in the sim)
Function: Queen (Makoto) strengthens herself using her Persona. (flavor line, no mechanic)
skill2: Fist of Justice!: This effect is continuous and cannot be removed. (buff-name label + dispel immunity; no dispel modeled)
Function: Queen (Makoto) strengthens herself. (flavor line, no mechanic)
Deactivation condition: When Full Burst ends. (no 'until Full Burst ends' removal primitive — approximated by ⚑ durationSec 10.4s = 22f chain gap + the 10s Full Burst window)

Affects all standard Burst 3 allies (except the skill user) in the Persona state. (target narrowed only to allies-except-self — there is no Burst-tier target primitive and no 'Persona state' concept; OVER-CREDITS on a Wind boss with non-Burst-III / non-Persona allies)

caveats: ⚑ Wind-gated majority: against the neutral/Fire scope-lock boss, skill1's Nuke Boost, skill2's Nuke Amp, the 1-More 548.99% rider, Baton Pass, and the 1 More ATK ▲30.27% are ALL inert. Any board movement from this override on a non-Wind boss comes only from ATK ▲50.28%, Attack Damage ▲30%, Distributed Damage ▲90.01%, and the burst nuke.
⚑ 'Fist of Justice!' duration is an estimate (10.4s), not a kit number — the kit states a Full-Burst-end deactivation condition instead of a duration.

⚑ '1 More' identity: modeled as HER OWN burst cast with a Wind Code enemy present, because that is the only line in this kit that grants it. If a collaborating unit can also grant '1 More', both 1-More-keyed blocks under-fire.
⚑ Baton Pass target is over-scoped (all allies except self) and its stacks are permanent (one per 1 More, cap 3 → steady state 3 from her third Wind-boss burst onward).

⚑ Burst-slot block order follows the kit's printed order: the 1421.69% nuke resolves BEFORE the 1 More ATK ▲30.27% self-buff, so the nuke does not benefit from it. Unverified — footage could show the reverse ordering.
⚑ Distributed damage against the single partless scope-lock boss is modeled as landing in FULL (no split); whether 'distributed' divides across enemy count is a kit-silent split-vs-merge question.
noFb is NOT set on any rider (default OFF, measured-only). The burst-slot nuke is Full-Burst-exempt by TIMING (a burst cast lands before the window opens), not by a flag.

flags.reasoning: The kit gives NO duration for 'Fist of Justice!' — it states a deactivation condition ('When Full Burst ends'). The schema has no 'until Full Burst ends' removal primitive, so the window must be expressed in seconds. From her own Burst-III cast to Full Burst start is the measured 22-frame chain gap (~0.37s); Full Burst is 10s ⇒ ~10.37s ≈ 10.4s. Under-shooting truncates the Elemental Advantage buff before the end of Full Burst; over-shooting leaks it into the post-FB window where the kit says it is gone.
flags.recipe: Record a Wind-boss fight with her as the Burst III caster; read the buff icon's disappearance frame against the Full-Burst banner-end frame. Alternatively pin with an engine test asserting the buffApply expiresFrame lands on the fullBurstEnd frame; if the engine later gains an 'until FB end' primitive, replace the constant rather than re-fitting it.

flags.estimate: 0 procs in any team this kit can form alone; unknown (≥1 per rotation) alongside whatever unit grants Follow Up
flags.reasoning: ALWAYS-⚑ class 2 (a damage line whose activation this kit never satisfies). Nothing in skill1/skill2/burst creates 'Follow Up' — unlike '1 More', which her own burst grants explicitly. Its sibling 'Persona state' wording in skill2's Baton Pass target shows this kit is written against a cross-unit collab mechanic. Inventing a trigger (interval / hitCount / fullBurstEnter) would fabricate up to 548.99% of final ATK per proc, which at a 10s cadence is comparable to a third of her burst nuke — a large, purely invented gain. A blind honest skip is correct here.
flags.recipe: Read the kit text of the partner collab unit(s) for a line that GRANTS 'Follow Up' (name + activation + cadence); then model this block with that trigger. Independently: a focus recording of Queen (Makoto) SOLO of the partner should show zero unexplained ~549%-of-ATK distributed popups — that alone confirms the inert reading for partner-less comps.

flags.estimate: Fires once per rotation in which SHE casts her burst, and only vs a Wind Code boss
flags.reasoning: '1 More' is a named state, and the only line that creates it is her burst's Wind-gated self-buff. Reading it as fullBurstEnter instead would over-credit in multi-Burst-III comps where another unit completes the chain; dropping the Wind gate would make it fire on every boss, roughly doubling her modeled distributed output vs a non-Wind boss where the kit intends nothing.
flags.recipe: Wind-boss recording: count 549%-of-ATK distributed popups against her burst casts (expect 1:1). Then a non-Wind boss recording: expect zero. If a collab partner can also grant 1 More, popups will exceed her own cast count — that is the discriminator.

flags.field: skill2[3].target (allies excludeSelf, standing in for 'Burst III allies in the Persona state')
flags.estimate: Over-credits by the number of non-Burst-III / non-Persona allies in the team (typically 3 of 4 allies in a standard comp)
flags.reasoning: TargetDef has no Burst-tier facet (teamHas has one, but that is a team GATE, not a target selector) and no representation of a 'Persona state'. Inert on the graded Fire-boss comps because of the Wind gate, so the error is latent, not live — but on any Wind fight the flat casterAtkPct 35.2 grant lands on allies the kit excludes.
flags.recipe: If a Burst-tier target primitive is added (alliesOfBurst), switch to it and gate the Persona-state clause by teamHas.slugs once the collab partner slugs are known. Meanwhile assert in a spec test that the buffApply target set on a Wind boss is exactly the allies you expect, so the approximation is visible rather than silent.

flags.field: skill2[3].effects[0] Baton Pass stack trajectory (maxStacks 3, no expiry)
flags.estimate: 1 stack per Wind-boss burst cast; steady state = 3 (cap) from her third burst, i.e. ~105.6% of her static ATK granted flat
flags.reasoning: ALWAYS-⚑ class 4. The kit states 'continuously' + 'Stacks up to 3 times' but not the accrual rate; the only stated stack source is 1 More, which is once per her burst. No consume/decay is stated, so the trajectory is a monotonic ramp to cap rather than a sawtooth — no haircut applied, but the first two rotations are below cap and the engine's instant-to-max default is NOT used here (stacks accrue naturally through repeated applications).
flags.recipe: Wind-boss recording: read the Baton Pass stack pip count on an ally after burst 1 / 2 / 3+ and confirm it holds at 3 with no decay across a Full Burst end. If it decays, add durationSec; if it caps earlier, adjust maxStacks.

flags.estimate: Riders crit at her sheet crit rate; no core (kit says no core strike)
flags.reasoning: Follows the standing rule that function-damage riders crit at the caster's rate and take no core unless the text says 'core strike damage'. Explicitly set so the model does not depend on a global rider-crit default flipping. Full Burst eligibility is left to TIMING (noFb not set) — her burst cast resolves before the Full Burst window opens, so the nuke is FB-exempt naturally, while the 1-More rider inherits whatever window it lands in.
flags.recipe: Popup colour read on a Wind-boss recording: orange/crit-iconed 549% and 1421% popups confirm crit eligibility; red 'CORE HIT' popups on those values would refute the no-core reading.

flags.estimate: Full value lands on the single boss (no split)
flags.reasoning: ALWAYS-⚑ class 5. 'Distributed damage' is kit-silent about whether the stated percentage is divided across the enemies present. The scope-lock boss is a single partless target, so the merged reading is the only one that can be scored — but it is an assumption, and it is the assumption that makes her burst nuke the largest single term in her modeled output.
flags.recipe: Compare her burst popup value against final ATK × 1421.69% × the known multiplier stack on a single-target fight; a systematic integer-fraction shortfall (½, ⅓) on a multi-enemy stage would expose a split.

flags.estimate: Use as given, but treat as datamine-unreliable
flags.reasoning: ALWAYS-⚑ class 1 — rate_of_fire and reloadFrames are the known-unreliable datamine fields, and the effective rate is quantised to 60fps boundaries (effective = 60/ceil(60/nominal)). For a shotgun this also sets the burst-gauge feed, since gauge credits per LANDED pellet. None of her kit lines modify ammo, reload, fire rate or pellet count, so no kit-side correction is available and the raw datamine drives her whole normal-attack economy.
flags.recipe: Focus recording: count trigger pulls per magazine and time reload start→first shot across several magazines; score against the harness's existing SG cadence pins before adjusting anything.
